Usage: memoriahub android publish [options] [apk]

Upload a built APK (default: the newest in dist/android) to the logged-in server

Arguments:
  apk             APK path; its sidecar .json must sit next to it

Options:
  --notes <text>  Release notes
  --no-current    Upload without making it the current release
  --force         Make it current even if its versionCode is not newer
  -h, --help      display help for command
